blocks.html: Your [[b]]Family Optometrist[[/b]] in Baton Rouge

[[b]]Welcome to Vue Eyecare[[/b]], your trusted partner in achieving optimal eye health and exceptional vision. Located in the heart of [[b]]Baton Rouge[[/b]], our practice is dedicated to providing the highest standard of personalized care.

We believe eyes are vital indicators of overall health. That’s why comprehensive eye care at Vue Eyecare goes far beyond a simple prescription. Led by [[b]]Dr. Phuong Dinh[[/b]], our team takes the time to truly get to know you, your history, and your specific vision goals.

Whether you are visiting for a routine exam, looking for the perfect pair of frames, or seeking advanced specialty solutions like [[b]]Ortho-K[[/b]] and [[b]]Scleral lenses[[/b]], we are here to cater to your needs with warmth and precision. At [[b]]Vue[[/b]] [[b]]Eyecare[[/b]], we see eye care through your eyes—providing the expert advice and follow-up you deserve.
[[b]]Quality[[/b]] Eye Care & [[b]]Treatment[[/b]]
[[a href="/eye-care-services/myopia-management/"]][[b]]Myopia[[/b]] Control »[[/a]]

Immediate attention for eye emergencies is vital. Our clinic is equipped to handle urgent eye care needs promptly and efficiently. Whether it’s an infection, injury, or sudden vision changes, our team provides expert care to address and treat your eye emergency with compassion and urgency.

blocks.html: [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-conditions/dry-eye-disease-and-treatment/"]][[b]]Dry Eye[[/b]] Treatment »[[/a]]

Experience relief from the discomfort of dry eyes with our specialized dry eye treatment. Tailored to address the unique causes of your symptoms, our approach combines advanced diagnostics with personalized therapy plans.
Comprehensive [[b]]Eye Exams[[/b]]

Regular eye exams are the cornerstone of maintaining optimal eye health. Our comprehensive eye exams go beyond just determining your prescription; they are a crucial check-up for detecting eye conditions and health issues at an early stage.
[[b]]Your[[/b]] Baton Rouge [[b]]Eye Doctor[[/b]]

The team at Vue Eyecare, led by Dr. P.T. Dinh, applies the latest, proven medical treatments, providing outstanding results in eye care. Dr. P.T. Dinh also offers eye care tips and advice to help you maintain healthy eyes and vision for life.

Dr. Phuong T. Dinh is an experienced and highly skilled optometrist proudly serving the community of Baton Rouge. He moved to the United States with his parents and older sister in 1974 following the Vietnam War and later graduated from Catholic High School. Dr. Dinh continued his education at Louisiana State University (LSU), where he earned his Bachelor of Science degree, and went on to complete both his Master of Science and Doctor of Optometry degrees at the University of Houston in 2005.Dr. Dinh provides comprehensive routine and medical eye care, including contact lens fittings, dry eye treatment, eye infection management, glaucoma care, and retinal evaluations.... Dr. Phuong T. Dinh is an experienced and highly skilled optometrist proudly serving the community of Baton Rouge. He moved to the United States with his parents and older sister in 1974 following the Vietnam War and later graduated from Catholic High School. Dr. Dinh continued his education at Louisiana State University (LSU), where he earned his Bachelor of Science degree, and went on to complete both his Master of Science and Doctor of Optometry degrees at the University of Houston in 2005.

Dr. Dinh provides comprehensive routine and medical eye care, including contact lens fittings, dry eye treatment, eye infection management, glaucoma care, and retinal evaluations. He holds advanced certification from the International Academy in Myopia Management and has specialized expertise in orthokeratology (Ortho-K) for myopia control, as well as scleral lens fitting for keratoconus and post–refractive surgery patients. He is known for his thorough, respectful, and patient-centered approach, always striving to deliver individualized care with professionalism and compassion.

Dr. Dinh has also participated in mission work providing essential eye care to underserved communities in Haiti and Honduras—experiences he considers deeply humbling and meaningful.[[br]]Appreciated for his warm personality and uplifting sense of humor, Dr. Dinh is often told by patients that he could pursue a second career in stand-up comedy—a compliment he receives with gratitude and good humor.

Outside of the exam room, Dr. Dinh enjoys country music, fishing, hunting, woodworking, playing guitar, cooking, baking, and traveling with his wife and two daughters. He considers it a true privilege to care for the eye health of individuals and families throughout Baton Rouge, Denham Springs, and the surrounding communities, as well, he remains committed to serving with integrity, compassion, and gratitude.
